É indispensável ter:

Senso de urgência.

A profissional precisa entender que, em uma controladoria jurídica, prazo não pode esperar .

Também é necessário ter capacidade para identificar rapidamente o que é urgente, o que é importante, o que precisa ser delegado e o que precisa ser escalado para a liderança.



O QUE ESPERAMOS DESSA PROFISSIONAL

Não buscamos apenas alguém para controlar prazos .

Buscamos uma profissional que seja capaz de organizar, fiscalizar, desenvolver e elevar a performance do jurídico .


INDICADORES DE DESEMPENHO

title: Rewards Partner Latam
description:
About the role

Leads the execution of the Total Rewards agenda across Latin America, translating strategy into impactful and scalable compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs that support Kerry's business and people priorities. This role partners closely with HR and business leaders to deliver market-competitive reward solutions, ensuring a seamless balance between employee experience, operational excellence, compliance, and cost effectiveness. Through strong stakeholder management, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement, the role drives consistent delivery, fosters cross-functional collaboration, and ensures Rewards programs create meaningful value for employees and the business.


Key responsibilities

Strategic Rewards Partner

  • Act as the trusted Rewards advisor to HR and business leaders across LATAM, translating global Rewards strategies into practical regional solutions that support business growth, talent priorities, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with HR Leadership Teams and business stakeholders to develop and execute Rewards programs that attract, retain, motivate, and engage talent while ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity.
  • Provide strategic guidance on compensation, benefits, recognition, incentive, and workforce planning matters, balancing business needs, employee experience, governance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Leverage market intelligence, analytics, and external benchmarking to identify trends, assess risks, and inform reward-related decisions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives, including restructures, acquisitions, integrations, and talent-related projects, ensuring Rewards considerations are effectively incorporated into business decisions.


Rewards Centre of Excellence Partner

  • Partner with Global Rewards and regional HR teams to implement and sustain Rewards programs, policies, frameworks, and governance across LATAM.
  • Drive the regional delivery of annual Rewards processes including salary reviews, incentive plans, market pricing, job architecture, pay transparency, and benefits governance.
  • Ensure Rewards programs remain compliant with local legislation, company policies, and regulatory requirements across the countries within scope.
  • Lead the assessment, design, and continuous improvement of Rewards programs to enhance employee value proposition, operational effectiveness, and cost management.
  • Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that improve understanding and adoption of Rewards programs among leaders, HR teams, and employees.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and coaching to HRBPs and people leaders on Rewards philosophy, policies, tools, and decision-making frameworks.


Business & Operational Execution

  • Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Global Rewards, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation of Rewards initiatives.
  • Support data-driven decision making through analysis, insights, and recommendations related to compensation, benefits, workforce costs, and talent outcomes.
  • Monitor Rewards program effectiveness through KPIs, market benchmarking, employee feedback, and governance reviews, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Drive high-quality execution of Rewards projects and processes, ensuring consistency, service excellence, and alignment with regional and global priorities.
  • Contribute to the development of regional guidelines, policies, and governance frameworks that enable scalable and sustainable Rewards practices across LATAM.


Qualifications and skills

- A Bachelor’s degree (Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or other applicable field)

- Minimum of ten (10) years broad based human resources experience, with significant experience at influencing;
Experience in the food/flavours manufacturing industry desirable

- English, Portuguese and Spanish language capability (fluent in writing, speaking)


About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

description:
GERENTE DE QUALIDADE - MULTINACIONAL DO SEGMENTO AUTOMOTIVO DE GRANDE PORTE

Curitiba/PR


Uma das maiores sistemistas e empresas globais de tecnologia para o setor automotivo, integrante da Fortune Global 500, busca um(a) Gerente de Qualidade para liderar a área em uma de suas principais operações industriais no Brasil, localizada em Curitiba/PR.


Buscamos uma liderança com trajetória consistente e robusta construída dentro da área da Qualidade e experiência relevante em ambientes industriais complexos dentro do segmento automotivo.


Não se trata de uma posição focada apenas em sistema, cliente ou qualidade de processo. Essa pessoa terá responsabilidade pela Qualidade da planta de forma ampla , desde o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e fornecedores até a produção em série, laboratórios, garantia, auditorias, sistema de gestão e atendimento aos clientes.


Sobre o desafio


Esta planta entra em um momento importante de expansão, com novos programas e um aumento significativo do volume previsto para os próximos anos.


Dentro desta nova perspectiva, o desafio será garantir que esse crescimento aconteça com processos robustos, métodos bem aplicados e capacidade de antecipar riscos antes que eles cheguem à produção ou ao cliente.


A operação reúne diferentes processos industriais, entre eles usinagem, transformação de alumínio, estampagem, corte e dobra e montagem , o que exige uma liderança com boa profundidade técnica, capacidade de fazer as perguntas certas e segurança para atuar e liderar especialistas que conhecem profundamente seus processos.


A cadeira também terá forte interface com Produção, Engenharia, Logística, Compras, fornecedores e clientes, além de conexão com as estruturas regionais e globais de Qualidade da companhia.


Esta é uma oportunidade para quem...


Gosta de estar próximo da fábrica e entende a Qualidade como uma função de prevenção, método e melhoria contínua, e não apenas de controle ou reação aos problemas.


Para quem tem curiosidade técnica, gosta de entender por que as coisas acontecem e não se contenta com a primeira resposta quando os dados mostram que ainda existe algo a investigar.

Buscamos alguém que saiba trabalhar com profissionais experientes e construir relações de confiança sem perder firmeza;
que tenha segurança para questionar processos, sustentar posicionamentos e tomar decisões mesmo diante de pressão de prazo, volume ou operação.


Também é uma cadeira para quem gosta de desenvolver pessoas e fortalecer estruturas. A equipe possui profissionais com senioridade e robusto conhecimento técnico, e parte importante do papel será aproveitar essa experiência, desenvolver novas referências e construir uma área cada vez mais autônoma e preparada para o futuro.


O legado dessa posição estará justamente em preparar a Qualidade para um novo patamar de operação, fortalecendo métodos, aumentando a capacidade preventiva da área, desenvolvendo o time e ajudando a planta a crescer sem perder robustez, disciplina e confiança dos clientes.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar a estrutura de Qualidade da planta, abrangendo Qualidade de Processo, Desenvolvimento, Laboratórios e Metrologia, Garantia, Auditorias, Fornecedores e Sistema de Gestão;
  • Assegurar a conformidade dos produtos e processos com os requisitos dos clientes, normas aplicáveis e diretrizes corporativas;
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de Qualidade, identificando riscos e conduzindo planos de melhoria;
  • Liderar a gestão de reclamações de clientes, não conformidades, contenções e ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Atuar de forma próxima à operação, fortalecendo a aplicação de métodos e ferramentas da Qualidade no chão de fábrica;
  • Apoiar novos projetos e lançamentos, garantindo maturidade de processo, produto e fornecedores;
  • Liderar auditorias internas, externas e de clientes;
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, formar sucessores e fortalecer as diferentes camadas de liderança da área;
  • Promover maior integração entre Qualidade, Produção, Engenharia, Logística, Compras e demais áreas;
  • Representar a Qualidade junto a clientes, fornecedores e à liderança da companhia;
  • Apoiar o desdobramento das estratégias regionais e globais de Qualidade na operação.


O perfil que buscamos


  • Trajetória sólida construída dentro da área da Qualidade em ambientes industriais complexos no segmento automotivo;
  • Experiência relevante em indústria automotiva, sistemistas ou operações de complexidade semelhante;
  • Vivência consistente com processos de usinagem , sendo experiência adicional com fundição ou transformação de alumínio, estampagem, conformação ou brasagem um diferencial importante;
  • Experiência em gestão da Qualidade de planta e liderança de equipes técnicas;
  • Domínio práticode ferramentas e metodologias como APQP, PPAP, FMEA, CEP/SPC, MSA, Problem Solving e sistemas de gestão;
  • Histórico de implantação e melhoria de métodos e processos de Qualidade;
  • Experiência comclientes, fornecedores, novos projetos e produção seriada;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e de investigação de problemas;
  • Maturidade paraliderar profissionais experientes, negociar, influenciar e assumir posicionamentos quando necessário;
  • Autonomia, iniciativa e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Formação superior compatível com a posição;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Curitiba/PR.


É uma posição para quem quer assumir uma operação relevante em um momento de crescimento e ter espaço para deixar uma contribuição concreta.


Mais do que manter o que já existe, o desafio será ajudar a construir uma Qualidade cada vez mais preventiva, consistente e preparada para sustentar o próximo ciclo da planta. Se esse momento de carreira fizer sentido para você, candidate-se e venha conversar conosco.

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.


The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.


This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.


Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.


You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.


Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.


What You'll Own


The Close and Financial Reporting


  • The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced.
  • Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on.
  • Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review.
  • Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you.
  • Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller.
  • External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.


Accounting Operations and Team


  • The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast.
  • The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606);
    leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.Com, or Rippling
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them
  • Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI
  • Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.


Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Product Designer Mobile & Web | Remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.


The role


You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

  • Product discovery and exploring new ideas
  • Turning early ideas into clear user journeys
  • Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems
  • Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs
  • Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing
  • Designing across iOS, Android and web
  • Working with and improving our design systems
  • Working closely with developers throughout implementation
  • Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users
  • Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.


What matters to us


Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

title: Controller
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.


We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence, satisfy its auditors, raise its next round, and scale.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Controller to own the accounting function of a high-growth US company, working remotely from LATAM.


This is the senior accounting seat in the business. You will be accountable for the integrity of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of the company for its audit. Where the company has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a control environment that exists in principle rather than in practice, an intercompany process that produces a different answer each quarter — you will be the person who rebuilds them.


You will work directly with the CEO, the finance leadership, and the department heads whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask.


Because you will be the most senior accounting person in the company and located outside the United States, the role calls for someone who operates well with autonomy, communicates proactively rather than on request, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture without a layer above them to catch what falls through.


What You'll Own


The Close and the Financial Statements


The close. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.


The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of leadership, auditors, and the board.

Final review. Hold final review authority over general ledger activity, journal entries, account reconciliations, and fixed assets.


Technical accounting. Research, document, and conclude on technical positions — revenue recognition, leases, equity, accruals, and capitalisation — and maintain the memoranda that support them.


Multi-entity accounting. Own consolidation across the group structure, including intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to the company's stage, and enforce them once established.


Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and SOPs that allow the function to operate without depending on any single individual.


Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.


Tax coordination. Coordinate US federal, state, and local tax compliance with external CPA firms, and own the accounting inputs those firms depend on.


Accounting Operations


The transactional cycle. Own AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.


Balance sheet integrity. Ensure reconciling items are resolved rather than carried forward, and that every balance has support a reviewer can follow.


Cash reporting. Maintain accurate cash reporting and reconciliation, and provide leadership with a reliable view of position and movement.


Business partnership. Provide FP&A and department leaders with the reporting packages, KPIs, variance analysis, and root-cause explanation that budgeting and forecasting depend on.


Team and Systems


The accounting team. Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team, and manage external accounting and bookkeeping partners against agreed standards and deadlines.


Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.


Process design. Build accounting processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and cycle time as the company grows, rather than processes that break at the next stage.


What We're Looking For


  • 8–10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of an accounting team
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and leases (ASC 842);
    familiarity with stock-based compensation (ASC 718) is an advantage
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks Online, or Xero, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.Com, Rippling, Gusto, or FloQast
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets;
    Power BI or comparable reporting tools an advantage
  • Experience acting as the senior accounting partner to executive leadership, including presenting results and defending conclusions
  • Comfort operating within a lean team, with the seniority to own the function and the willingness to prepare the entry yourself when circumstances require it
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Preferred


  • CPA, Contador Público, CRC-registered Contador, CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS, professional services, or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR
  • Board, lender, and management reporting experience
  • Exposure to US multi-state tax, international entities, or transfer pricing is welcome


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own a function outright rather than administer one part of it.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you, and you are equally credible in a room with a CEO, an auditor, and a junior accountant.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


Own an entire accounting function, end to end, with direct exposure to founders and senior leadership


Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's

Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities


Sit close to the decisions that depend on your numbers, with visible impact on the outcome


Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI

Work remotely with US-based leadership, in substantial overlap with the US business day

Receive MAVI's support throughout placement, onboarding, and the engagement that follows


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role. You will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners, and you will be placed with a single client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts.


Candidates based in LATAM will maintain near-full overlap with the US business day. Candidates based in India should expect a structured afternoon-to-evening schedule providing a firm overlap against US Eastern hours.

title: Cpg Supply Chain Manager
description:
CPG Supply Chain Manager

Location: Remote (LATAM based)

Employment Type: Full time

Salary: $35K USD


About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated, full time Supply Chain Manager to own demand planning, vendor management, and wholesale replenishment across our portfolio of consumer products brands. This is a company with multiple direct to consumer subscription brands, one single purchase DTC brand, and two wholesale brands sold through major retail partners.


This role sits at the center of our supply chain operations, working closely with our warehouse team, finance, and brand leads to keep inventory accurate, purchase orders on schedule, and reporting visible to leadership. You will be the person who catches a forecasting error before it becomes a stockout, who flags an FBA shipment deadline before it slips, and who builds the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership see inventory health at a glance across every brand and channel.


This is a dedicated, single client role. You will not be splitting your time or attention across other companies or accounts.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Order and Inventory Accuracy Across Channels

  • Own the process of pulling sales orders across all sales channels, including wholesale retail partners and marketplace channels, and ensuring inventory is accurately and promptly decremented as orders ship from our warehouse
  • Maintain a real time, accurate view of true available inventory at all times, since forecasting, reordering, and fulfillment decisions all depend on this number being correct
  • Review and reconcile weekly cycle count data provided by the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator against expected inventory levels based on sales order activity
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, tracing issues back to root cause, whether that is a sales order processing error, a receiving error, or a physical count error
  • Note: this role reviews and reconciles cycle count data but does not have supervisory authority over the warehouse coordinator, who reports separately to the Senior Operations Manager

Demand Planning and Forecasting

  • Analyze sales velocity across all DTC brands and forecast demand by SKU
  • Determine and execute reorder timing and quantities for DTC brands to avoid stockouts and overstock
  • Incorporate seasonality trends and channel performance data from ecommerce, Amazon, retail marketplace, and social commerce channels into forecasting and reorder decisions

Vendor, Production, and Purchase Order Management

  • Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations
  • Track supplier lead times and follow up on delayed shipments
  • Coordinate directly with our overseas production team on reorder needs, production timing, and inventory availability
  • Maintain steady vendor relationships and communication, particularly when timelines get tight

Marketplace Fulfillment Management

  • Own the shipment calendar and deadline tracking for inventory sent into third party fulfillment centers (including Amazon FBA), ensuring shipments are submitted on time to prevent sales disruption
  • Proactively flag potential shortages or overstock situations before they affect sales

Wholesale Replenishment

  • Track replenishment needs and inventory levels for our wholesale retail partners
  • Coordinate with wholesale retailer portals and contacts on stock levels, reorder timing, and order minimums
  • Ensure wholesale order planning accounts for retailer specific lead times and minimum order requirements

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain organized, accessible documentation for vendor contracts and communications
  • Maintain a formal reorder tracker and replenishment schedule, kept current and accessible to leadership
  • Build and maintain regular reporting on inventory health, discrepancy trends, and stock levels across all brands, giving leadership clear and reliable visibility
  • Proactively communicate inventory risks and planning recommendations directly to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked
  • Support cross functional projects tied to supply chain systems or reporting improvements


What We Are Looking For

  • Prior experience in supply chain management, demand planning, or inventory management, ideally spanning both DTC and wholesale or retail channels
  • Experience coordinating directly with overseas manufacturing or production teams, including production timing and reorder communication, is strongly preferred
  • Experience with Amazon marketplace operations, including FBA shipment coordination, is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working in Excel or Google Sheets for forecasting and reporting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with vendors, retail partners, and internal teams
  • A proactive, detail oriented mindset with genuine ownership over deadlines and follow through
  • Ability to work as a dedicated, full time resource for a single company
  • Comfort working independently in a remote structure with regular reporting cadence to leadership

Why Join Our Team

  • A stage of company where you will help build supply chain infrastructure and reporting from the ground up, not just follow existing systems
  • Full ownership of demand planning and wholesale replenishment across multiple brands
  • A collaborative, low ego team environment where your work has direct, visible impact
  • Steady operational culture that values reliable execution and clear communication

title: Consultor De Investimentos - Wealth
description:
Sobre a Altside

A Altside é a 1ª consultoria de investimentos do Brasil focada em criptomoedas. Acreditamos que liberdade e soberania sobre o próprio patrimônio só existem de verdade quando viram tempo;
tempo para estar com a família, para se aposentar mais cedo, para viver a vida que o dinheiro deveria liberar, não prender. Por isso, ajudamos pessoas e famílias a acelerarem a construção de patrimônio, unindo o melhor do mercado tradicional e cripto em estratégias personalizadas de investimento.


Pra quem é essa vaga

Aqui você não espera "o tempo de casa" para assumir responsabilidade de verdade;
quem entrega bem, ganhaespaço rápido. Se você busca um ambiente onde pode propor, errar, ajustar e crescer, vai se sentir em casa. É também um lugar para quem quer aprender rápido: você vai estar perto de quem decide, com acesso direto para entender o porquê das coisas — não só o que fazer.


O que você vai encontrar aqui

  • Você vai ter autonomia com responsabilidade;
  • Vai estar pertode pessoas e líderes excelentes: horizontalidade não é discurso, é realidade;
  • E vai atuar numlugar que trata honestidade, com cliente e entre as pessoas, como o não-negociável mais intrínseco.


Quem nós buscamos

Uma pessoa com histórico sólido em relacionamento com investidores e paixão real pelo mercado cripto.


Alguém com bagagem para lidar com clientes exigentes, capacidade consultiva para gerar valor estratégico a partir do relacionamento e visão para conduzir o cliente a novos níveis de independência financeira, usando o mercado cripto como ferramenta.


Esperamos um perfil maduro, analítico e empático, que saiba equilibrar performance e propósito, e que se identifique com a missão da Altside de promover liberdade e soberania financeira.


Você será responsável por

  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento, construção de carteiras e planejamento financeiro e sucessório com clientes da base;
  • Aprofundar e fortalecer o relacionamento com investidores, identificando oportunidades para novos aportes e migração de capital do mercado tradicional para cripto;
  • Acompanhar a jornada do cliente em todas as 4 etapas da metodologia Altside: Construção, Otimização, Planejamento e Sucessão;
  • Ser o ponto de contato estratégico dos clientes, garantindo clareza, proximidade e confiança em cada interação;
  • Participar da avaliação e refinamento de processos junto ao time de Produto, garantindo coerência com a jornada real do cliente;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Research, Marketing, Comercial e Produto para garantir que a experiência do cliente seja sempre personalizada e de alto valor;
  • Apoiar o crescimento da operação com feedbacks, visão estratégica e construção de uma cultura centrada no cliente.


Quais as habilidades necessárias


Hardskills

  • Experiência sólida em relacionamento com investidores e gestão de clientes de alta renda (consultoria, assessoria, private etc.);
  • Domínio do mercado cripto, especialmente Bitcoin, DeFi e estratégias de alocação digital;
  • Habilidade paraconduzir conversas estratégicas e personalizadas com diferentes perfis de cliente;
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de portfólios, relatórios e KPIs de desempenho.


Softskills

  • Comunicação clara, consultiva e com escuta ativa;
  • Capacidade de gerar confiança e orientar decisões com foco no resultado do cliente;
  • Visão estratégica e liderança colaborativa baseada em exemplo e entrega;
  • Organização e priorização de tarefas em múltiplas frentes;
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir com rapidez.


Detalhes importantes

  • Local de trabalho: Presencial (escritório em Florianópolis – bairro Saco Grande);
  • Remuneração: Fixo mensal + comissão mensal + bônus semestral;

#VemPraAtvos

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Agronomia, Engenharia Agronômica ou demais Engenharias correlatas.

  • Perfil com forte orientação para resultados, capacidade analítica, organização e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

title: Hydraulic Technician To Work In Australia (5+ Years' Experience Required)
description:
5+years' experience required.


About Us:

Kempe Engineering is an Australian owned company with 16 permanent facilities located in close proximity to our client’s operations nationally in Australia (refer to website

Our company is committed to ZERO Harm delivering exceptional performance to our clients. As an essential service provider, we offer continuity of employment including career development into leadership & management roles. Our growth industries include renewable energy, recycling, food & dairy and mining.

We are seeking experienced Hydraulic / Fluid Power Service Technicians to join our Australian branches teams to install, maintain, troubleshoot, repair and perform preventative maintenance of mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

  • Using testing equipment to diagnose, repair and maintain fluid power components and systems

  • Develop and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including site owner representatives


Qualifications, Skills & Experience:

To be successful the following knowledge and experience is required:

  • A trade qualification as a fitter or equivalent with hydraulic experience
  • Experience in hydraulic hose assemblies, tube manufacture and installation
  • Formal fluid power post trade training or relevant industry experience would be highly regarded
  • Have a high safety focus
  • A current driver’s license
  • Be able to pass pre-employment medical


Benefits:

  • A family-based work culture
  • Attractive salary package
  • Ability to both work across multiple sites and a workshop
  • Opportunity for career development

Benefits

- Morning snack;

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Science & Technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in science and technology will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of scientific and technological topics.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, and related fields.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, technical correctness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field;
    degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.


Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.

  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified Art Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in art will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse art-related topics.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering art history, visual arts, fine arts, architecture, design, artists, art movements, museums, and related topics.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in any field;
    degrees in Art History,Fine Arts, Visual Arts, Museum Studies, Cultural Studies, Design, Humanities, or other art-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of art, including familiarity with major artists, artworks, art movements, styles, periods, techniques, museums, cultural traditions, and developments in visual arts.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in art research, academia, museums, galleries, curation, art criticism or journalism, education, publishing, arts and cultural content, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to assess artistic, historical, and cultural information accurately and within the appropriate context.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.


Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Fp&A Manager - Remote (Work From Anywhere)
description:
About the job

Own SaaS Financial Planning. Drive US Business Strategy. Lead from Brazil.


MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting and finance professionals directly into their teams. In Mexico, we focus on building long-term partnerships — where professionals operate as a true extension of US finance teams, not just offshore support.


This is not traditional outsourcing. You will work directly with US founders, Controllers, and finance leaders in lean, fast-moving environments.


The Opportunity

We are hiring an FP&A Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for US-based SaaS clients with structured corporate finance operations. You will own the full planning cycle — from budget build to monthly reporting — while acting as a strategic finance partner to US CFOs and business leaders.


This role is designed for an experienced FP&A professional who understands SaaS unit economics, recurring revenue models, and how finance drives decision-making in high-growth tech companies.


What You Will Own

  • Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting for US SaaS clients
  • Build and maintain financial models covering ARR, MRR, churn, and unit economics
  • Own monthly variance reporting with actionable business commentary for US leadership
  • Partner with US CFOs and senior leaders on strategic planning and scenario analysis
  • Develop KPI dashboards and financial performance frameworks
  • Analyze SaaS metrics including CAC, LTV, gross margin, and cohort retention
  • Support board-level reporting, investor presentations, and fundraising data

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, metrics, and recurring revenue dynamics
  • Experience working within or directly supporting corporate-structured SaaS companies
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities

  • Advanced English with strong executive communication skills
  • Ability to work consistently in US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?

  • Direct partnership with US CFOs and SaaS finance leadership teams
  • Own strategic FP&A for high-growth US tech businesses
  • Exposure to corporate-level finance in a fully remote setup
  • Competitive compensation and long-term client partnerships

title: Head Of Accounting
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.


We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.


This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.


Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.


The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.


You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.


What You'll Own


The Close and Financial Reporting


  • The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.
  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.


Team, Systems, and Standard


  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.


What We're Looking For


  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606);
    leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.Com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity


As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.


This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.


What You Will Own


  • Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar
  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached
  • Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them
  • Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards
  • Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding
  • Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team
  • Prepare PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries in your areas through to resolution
  • Operate within the client's accounting policies and controls, and flag where a control is followed in form but not in substance
  • Maintain the close checklists and SOPs that keep the close reproducible without depending on any single individual
  • Propose process improvements and automation that shorten the close


What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle end to end, rather than contribution to one part of it
  • Experience preparing full financial statements, including cash flow, for review
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the judgment to know when a balance does not look right
  • Experience supporting an audit, including PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Toast, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • CA / CPA / ACCA (or equivalent), or active progress toward one, preferred
  • Excellent English communication, with the ability to explain an accounting outcome to a non-accountant
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?


  • Carry a full close end to end for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Own real areas of a growing company's books rather than one corner of them
  • Gain exposure to audit, ERP work, and process design earlier than a comparable in-house role would offer
  • Clear progression to Accounting Team Lead, Accounting Manager, and Controller roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: Técnico De Operações - Brasília/Df
description:

O portfólio de produtos também inclui sistemas de produção de hidrogênio sustentável, como eletrolisadores e reformadores a vapor, as principais tecnologias para a demanda futura por energia limpa. Experiência como operador de processos com gases sob alta pressão;

Habilidade com softwares de gestão e operação;

title: Analista De Estratégia E Operações
description:
• SOBRE NÓS

A ZAWA é uma empresa em crescimento contínuo no setor de importação e e-commerce, com atuação consolidada há mais de oito anos nos principais marketplaces do país. Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios:

  • Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.
  • Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.
  • Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.
  • Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.
  • Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.


  • SOBRE A VAGA

Cargo: Analista de Estratégia e Operações (Atuação direta com o CEO | Trilha de desenvolvimento para Gerência Operacional)

Local: Sede administrativa – Rebouças, Curitiba/PR

Tipo de contratação: CLT

Remuneração: R$ 4.000,00 bruto (após experiência)

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição (R$ 400,00/Mês) + VT
  • Bonificação trimestral e anual por desempenho conforme política da empresa


  • ATRIBUIÇÕES

O Analista de Estratégia e Operações é responsável por apoiar o desenvolvimento, a integração e a melhoria contínua dos processos da empresa, atuando diretamente com o CEO e adquirindo uma visão ampla do negócio. Sua atuação combina análise de dados, gestão de processos, resolução de problemas e acompanhamento operacional, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência, escalabilidade e sustentabilidade da operação. A posição possui uma trilha estruturada de desenvolvimento para assumir funções crescentes de gestão e liderança ao longo do tempo. Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Aprender e compreender profundamente os processos, indicadores, sistemas e rotinas dos setores de Vendas, Financeiro, Importação, Logística, SAC e RH;
  • Acompanhar diretamente o CEO nas atividades de gestão, planejamento, tomada de decisão e execução de projetos estratégicos;
  • Monitorar indicadores, metas, projetos e planos de ação, contribuindo para a execução das prioridades da empresa;
  • Consolidar informações, realizar análises e elaborar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos, ineficiências e oportunidades de melhoria, propondo soluções estruturadas para os desafios operacionais;
  • Mapear, documentar, padronizar e otimizar processos, promovendo maior eficiência, controle, continuidade e escalabilidade operacional;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, integração de sistemas e aplicação de tecnologias e Inteligência Artificial para ganho de produtividade;
  • Participar da implantação, validação e melhoria de sistemas, ferramentas e processos operacionais;
  • Facilitar a comunicação e integração entre áreas, garantindo alinhamento entre processos, pessoas e objetivos organizacionais;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas, acompanhando práticas, indicadores e processos relacionados às equipes;
  • Assumir progressivamente responsabilidades de gestão, conforme demonstrar autonomia e maturidade profissional;


  • REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃO

Competências obrigatórias:

  • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Gestão, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel intermediário real, com domínio e agilidade em fórmulas, funções lógicas, buscas, tratamento e cruzamento de dados;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Uso recorrente de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao trabalho.

Competências desejadas:

  • Experiência em E-commerce;
  • Análise de dados;
  • Conhecimentos de contabilidade, DRE, BP ou finanças empresariais;
  • Experiência comERP, HUBs ou sistemas de gestão;
  • Vivência com liderança ou desenvolvimento de pessoas.


  • EXPECTATIVAS

O que buscamos:

  • Alta capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico estruturado;
  • Facilidade paraaprender rapidamente novos processos, ferramentas e conceitos;
  • Interesse genuíno por gestão, operações, negócios e desenvolvimento organizacional;
  • Perfil organizado, disciplinado e orientado para resultados;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de síntese e objetividade;
  • Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e otimização de processos;
  • Senso de responsabilidade e autonomia, com interesse em construir uma trajetória de longo prazo e assumir responsabilidades cada vez maiores;
  • Curiosidade intelectual, proatividade e disposição para aprender continuamente;
  • Alinhamento comvalores como serenidade, capricho, maestria, responsabilidade e melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos:

  • Atuação próxima à Diretoria, com visão ampla e estratégica do negócio;
  • Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal;
  • Direcionamento estratégico;

title: Senior Sell-Out Sales Manager
description:
Haier Smart Home has arrived in Brazil and is looking for a Senior Sell-out Sales Manager to join its team.


Work Modality: On-site work, in São Paulo - SP.


Responsabilities:

  • Undertake and complete regional terminal sell-out sales targets, track daily/weekly/monthly retail sales data, analyze sales gaps, formulate targeted terminal sales improvement plans and implement them efficiently;
  • Optimize channel inventory management, monitor the inventory turnover status of distributors and retail terminals in real time, reasonably adjust product delivery and sales rhythm, reduce overstock and out-of-stock risks, and improve inventory capital turnover efficiency;
  • Guide and assist offline retail stores, distributors and sales teams to carry out terminal sales promotion, product display optimization, sales skill training and customer service upgrading, and improve terminal retail conversion rate and customer repurchase rate;
  • Analyze terminal sales data including product sales structure, hot-selling/slow-moving SKUs, regional sales differences and consumer preference characteristics, put forward product matching and sales strategy optimization suggestions, and drive sales structure upgrading;
  • Organize and implement terminal localized promotion activities, seasonal marketing campaigns and retail incentive policies, stimulate the sales enthusiasm of terminal sales staff and distributors, and boost short-term sell-out increment;
  • Track the terminal sales performance of competing brands, summarize their terminal promotion methods, pricing strategies and retail operation models, formulate differentiated terminal sales countermeasures, and enhance Haier’s terminal market competitiveness;
  • Establish a standardized terminal sales management system, sort out sell-out business process specifications, regularly conduct terminal sales audits and effect evaluations, and form closed-loop management of terminal sales business;
  • Cooperate with the marketing, supply chain and channel management teams to ensure the matching of terminal product supply, promotional resources and sales policies, and fully guarantee the completion of sell-out targets.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Management, Retail Operation or related majors;
  • Experience in terminal sell-out operation and sales management experience in Brazil’s home appliance/retail industry, familiar with local offline retail terminal operation logic and sales management modes;
  • Experience in terminal sales breakthrough, inventory optimization and retail team activation, with outstanding data analysis capability and practical problem-solving ability for terminal sales scenarios;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, proficient in local business communication and terminal team management, able to independently launch terminal sales promotion projects;
  • Sensitive to sales data, able to quickly locate terminal sales pain points, formulate executable improvement plans, and focus on result-oriented target delivery;
  • Strong execution, on-site management ability and pressure resistance, good at team motivation and cross-team business collaboration;
  • Familiar with the retail market rules and consumer characteristics of Brazil’s home appliance industry.

title: Ombudsman / Ouvidor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is looking for a qualified Ombudsman (Ouvidor) to manage the mandatory Ouvidoria structure for our regulated VASP entity under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025, Resolution BCB No. 28/2021, and CMN Resolution No. 4,860/2020.

Serving as the second-instance escalation mechanism, the Ombudsman acts independently from operational and sales teams, championing client rights and reporting systemic insights directly to top management.


Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Second-Instance Complaints: Receive, register, and resolve complex client complaints escalated from standard customer service (SAC) within mandatory BCB resolution timeframes.
  • Independent Mediation: Act as an impartial mediator between clients and internal operational units.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring operational failures or systemic compliance risks and recommend corrective action plans to executive leadership.
  • BCB & Board Reporting: Prepare periodic Ombudsman reports (Relatório de Ouvidoria ) detailing complaint volume, resolution metrics, and root cause analyses for internal governance and BCB regulatory filings.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven background in Client Advocacy, Ombudsman (Ouvidoria), Legal, or Regulatory Compliance within BCB-regulated financial institutions, payments, or crypto platforms.
  • Consumer Law: Solid working knowledge of the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (Código de Defesa do Consumidor - CDC) and BCB Ouvidoria regulations.
  • Certifications: Active Ombudsman Certification (Certificação de Ouvidoria by Anbima, Febraban, or Abecip), required.
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory) and professional working English (preferred).


Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory Compliance & Dispute Resolution: Deep understanding of BCB consumer protection frameworks, Resolution BCB 28/2021, CMN 4,860/2020, and the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (CDC ).
  • Executive Presence: Ability to act as an autonomous authority, presenting independent semi-annual Ombudsman reports (Relatórios de Ouvidoria ) to the Board of Directors and BCB examiners.
  • Strong Analytical & Root-Cause Analysis Skills: Capability to analyze complaint data, identify recurring product/operational bottlenecks, and drive structural recommendations.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Strong commitment to meeting strict regulatory response deadlines (BCB SLA requirements) and managing regulatory exposure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mediation: Proven ability to liaise neutrally between aggrieved customers, internal business lines, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams.
  • Ability to build scalable dispute resolution infrastructure: Capacity to design and scale second-instance ticketing systems, automated SLA tracking, and complaint reporting workflows tailored for fast-growing financial platforms.


Nice to Have

  • Fintech & Cross-Border Experience: Background handling complex customer grievances related to international wire transfers, eFX exchange rates, Pix transactions, or digital asset settlements.
  • BACEN Reporting Exposure: Prior experience inputting data into or submitting regulatory complaint reports through official BCB reporting portals (Unifoco/RDR).
  • Legal/Regulatory Background: Formal education or background in Legal, Consumer Law, or Compliance within regulated financial institutions (IPs/SDFs/VASPs) in Brasil.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
